title: US Pacific Command seeks $122 bn, warns of rising threat of war with China-Washington Times report
description: In his report to US Congress, Admiral Paparo reiterated warnings that the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) has been ordered to prepare for military operations against Taiwan by 2027.

title: Taiwan Accuses China of Pressuring Kenya to Block Taiwanese Experts From Attending Our Ocean Conference
description: Taiwan has accused China of pressuring Kenya to block Taiwanese experts from attending the Our Ocean Conference in Mombasa. Taipei said delegates were denied access despite official invitations, calling the move diplomatic intimidation and a blow to international cooperation and inclusivity.

title: Taiwan’s foreign minister says Chinese pressure on countries over the island is a ‘new normal’
description: TAIPEI, Taiwan — Attempts by China to exert pressure or influence on other countries to limit Taiwan’s access to international events has become “the new normal,” the island’s foreign minister said Wednesday.

title: Taiwan says its delegates have been barred from ocean conference in Kenya
description: Kenya has barred delegates from Taiwan from attending an international conference on oceans in the east African ​country under pressure from China, Taiwan's government said.

title: China accused of bullying as Taiwan delegates barred from global ocean conference in Kenya
description: According to The Taipei Times, the controversy emerged after Taiwanese academics, who had been officially invited by Kenyan authorities, travelled to Kenya and attended a pre-conference exchange event where they presented research and policy reports. However, the delegates were later denied access to the main conference after Kenyan officials refused to recognise their Taiwanese passports.

title: Taiwan says its delegates have been barred from ocean conference in Kenya
description: Kenya has barred Taiwanese delegates from attending an international ocean conference under pressure from China, which claims Taiwan as its own territory.
